plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: the menu with every allergen, today's specials and what's sold out (or fresh out of the oven) from a sheet you edit on your phone, table requests on WhatsApp, delivery links, reviews and a Plan your visit page.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: the full menu with the allergen chart, takeaway orders with the total and allergens, events, private dining or Can I work here?, the live walk-in board and the regulars' board.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces (for restaurants The Table, The Room and The Pass; for cafés Your usual, the glass case, how busy it is, the seat finder and the brunch builder) and something made just for you.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds up to four more pages, like this one: the full menu and allergen chart, takeaway, events and private dining.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: The Table, The Room and The Pass for restaurants; Your usual, the glass case, how busy it is, the seat finder and the brunch builder for cafés.
